system.description: The one who Sejders up a spell molds the vitner using different movements and gestures. The conjurer must therefore be able to use both their hands for weaving. Otherwise they cannot control the vitner needed for the spell. This spell method is quiet but startling since the conjurer must gesticulate with both arms and hands.
system.summary: Shapes the vitner through movements and two-handed gestures; silent yet spectacular.
